cornkkob: Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob came up with a draft of replacements on Day 3. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
Leopold "Doc" Cornkkob's transfer to the role of machine gunner was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.
gremlin_jngaf: Konrad Jngaf arrived at R-F15 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Volunteer number 77. The quartermaster pinned the First Wave ribbon on Konrad Jngaf's tunic and said: 'Don't let the mud have it.'
Orders came through: Konrad Jngaf is a sniper now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a key to a house that is no longer there.
Konrad Jngaf repaired the strap on Jakub Ebrrrvole's pack. Payment was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Konrad Jngaf was on wiring party in no man's land. Every time a flare went up he froze like a scarecrow. It worked.
